nodes.summary: Bell numbers (Dobinski, Spivey, Touchard and Turán-type identities, log-convexity), complete, partial and generalized Bell polynomials, potential polynomials, Fubini (ordered Bell) numbers and their congruences, and horse numbers.
nodes.title: Bell numbers, Fubini numbers and Bell polynomials

nodes.summary: Combinatorial formulas for Bernoulli, Euler, tangent and Genocchi numbers (Garabedian's formulas, median Euler and Genocchi numbers, Euler–Seidel matrices, Carlitz q-Bernoulli polynomials), their divisibility, and sums of powers via Faulhaber coefficients.
nodes.title: Bernoulli, Euler and Genocchi numbers

nodes.summary: Counting permutations by descents or excedances: Eulerian numbers and polynomials, refined, multiset and generalized Eulerian polynomials, associated Stirling–Eulerian numbers, Worpitzky's identity, gamma-positivity and Hankel determinants of Eulerian polynomials, Bell permutations by weak excedances.
nodes.title: Eulerian numbers and polynomials

nodes.summary: Deformations and generalizations of Stirling numbers: r-Stirling, associated Stirling, Hsu–Shiue, Jacobi–Stirling, Legendre–Stirling, meromorphic and degenerate Stirling numbers, α-Stirling and generalized Stirling matrices, and (q,r)-Whitney and Dowling numbers.
nodes.title: Generalized Stirling numbers

nodes.summary: Classical Stirling numbers of the first and second kind and Lah numbers: recurrences, explicit and addition formulas, rising and falling factorial expansions, orthogonality and inverse Stirling matrices, cycle counts, inequalities and identities such as Lee's and Gy's.
nodes.title: Stirling and Lah numbers

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
